title: DSPy Program Execution
summary: This module defines the core components for building and executing DSPy programs. It orchestrates language model interactions, retrieval mechanisms, and advanced prediction strategies to create robust and adaptable LLM-powered applications.

nodes.label: Base DSPy Program Module
nodes.title: DSPy Base Module
nodes.description: The foundational class for all DSPy programs, providing the structure and execution flow for orchestrating LLM and retrieval components.

nodes.label: LLM Interaction Signatures
nodes.title: DSPy Signature Definition
nodes.description: Defines the declarative blueprints for structuring prompts and expected outputs for Language Model calls, ensuring clear communication with LLMs.

nodes.label: Advanced Prediction Strategies
nodes.title: Advanced Prediction Modules
nodes.description: Implements sophisticated LLM interaction patterns like ReAct, Program of Thought, and Best-of-N to enhance reasoning and output quality.

nodes.label: Information Retrieval Mechanisms
nodes.title: DSPy Retrieval Modules
nodes.description: Provides tools for integrating various retrieval systems, including local indexes and external vector databases, to fetch relevant context for LLMs.

nodes.label: Language Model Client
nodes.title: LM Client Integration
nodes.description: Handles communication with various Language Models, sending requests and receiving responses, often managed by the `lm_integration` module.

nodes.label: Program Input Data
nodes.title: Program Input
nodes.description: The initial data or query provided to a DSPy program for processing.

nodes.label: Program Output Data
nodes.title: Program Output
nodes.description: The final result or answer generated by the DSPy program after executing its logic.

groups.label: Program Orchestration
groups.title: Core Program Execution
groups.description: The central orchestrator of DSPy programs, managing the flow of execution and integration of various components.

groups.label: LLM Interaction Layer
groups.title: LLM Interaction Strategies
groups.description: Components that define how Language Models are prompted and how their responses are processed, including advanced reasoning patterns.

groups.label: Data Flow & Retrieval
groups.title: Data Flow and Context Retrieval
groups.description: Manages the input and output of the program, along with mechanisms for retrieving external information to enrich LLM context.

groups.label: External LM Integration
groups.title: External Language Model Integration
groups.description: Represents the interface to external Language Model services that perform the actual text generation.
